coaching.label: This month's tip
coaching.whyNote: From research on families. A finding, not a promise.

contribution-vs-bonus.title: Everyday help is family work
contribution-vs-bonus.body: Keep daily help unpaid. Pay coins for extra tasks only.
contribution-vs-bonus.why: Paying for everything can crowd out wanting to help.

price-by-effort.title: Price bonus tasks by effort
price-by-effort.body: Pay more for longer, harder tasks. Keep prices steady.
price-by-effort.why: Steady prices give coins a value your child can plan with.

keep-promises.title: Keep reward promises on time
keep-promises.body: Answer requests quickly and give rewards as promised.
keep-promises.why: Children wait longer when waiting reliably pays off.

explain-the-no.title: Give every no a reason
explain-the-no.body: Say why, and what your child can do next.
explain-the-no.why: Unexplained refusals make children share less with parents.

ask-their-view.title: Ask what they think first
ask-their-view.body: Before you decide, ask your child why they want it.
ask-their-view.why: Two-way talks prepare children better than instructions alone.

money-talk-at-home.title: Let them see your choices
money-talk-at-home.body: Say out loud how you decide on a purchase.
money-talk-at-home.why: Children learn from what you do, not only from rules.

after-a-goal.title: After a goal, ask what's next
after-a-goal.body: When a goal is reached, help plan the next one.
after-a-goal.why: Saving often slows right after a goal. A new one helps.

limits-with-reasons.title: Explain the limits you set
limits-with-reasons.body: Share the reason for a limit and review it together.
limits-with-reasons.why: Rules with reasons are followed more willingly.

grow-their-say.title: Give more say, step by step
grow-their-say.body: As your child shows care, raise their independence level.
grow-their-say.why: Gradual independence works better than all at once.

spending-is-not-failing.title: Spending is a choice too
spending-is-not-failing.body: When coins go fast, ask what your child learned.
spending-is-not-failing.why: Spending now can be sensible when waiting has not paid off.

share-for-real.title: Make sharing real
share-for-real.body: Choose together where Share coins go, then do it.
share-for-real.why: Giving feels real when it reaches a real place.

bonus-is-not-interest.title: The bonus is not interest
bonus-is-not-interest.body: Tell your child the bonus is a family reward, not bank interest.
bonus-is-not-interest.why: Even adults misjudge how interest grows. Keep it simple.

reflection.prompt: What would you tell {name} about this?
reflection.hint: Only you see this. It is not saved.

pricing.contribution: Everyday family help: unpaid, or a coin or two.
pricing.bonus: Bonus tasks: pay by effort and time. Keep prices steady.
pricing.promise: Pay what you promised, when you promised it.

limitNote.reason: Tell your child why the limit exists.
limitNote.review: Look at it together as they grow.

scope.heading: What this practice covers
scope.intro: Practice with coins that stay in the app. No real money moves.
scope.earning: Earning coins for tasks, and helping at home.
scope.splitting: Splitting coins into save, spend and share.
scope.goals: Saving toward goals and waiting for them.
scope.asking: Asking for rewards and hearing the reason.
scope.debt: Debt, or paying it back with interest.
scope.compounding: Real compound interest. The weekly bonus is not interest.
scope.why: These are hard to teach well, so we leave them out.

dataPolicy.heading: Your family's data
dataPolicy.lead: How long we keep each kind.
dataPolicy.photos: Chore photos: {days} days after your decision.
dataPolicy.records: Chores, rewards, decisions and notes: {days} days.
dataPolicy.coins: Coins, goals and rules: while the account exists.
dataPolicy.insights: Usage insights: {days} days, only with your consent.
dataPolicy.research: Research: only if you say yes, up to {days} days.
dataPolicy.erasure: Deleting an account deletes all of it.
dataPolicy.sharing: Never shared with advertisers or the Mentor's AI.

research.heading: Help us learn
research.what: We study if practice here helps later in life.
research.how: We keep monthly totals, never names, notes or titles.
research.never: No experiments on children. Nothing changes for {name}.
research.stop: Stop any time, and we delete it.
research.failed: This did not save. Try again.

myResearch.heading: Research
myResearch.body: Your Tutor lets us learn from your coin totals.
myResearch.stop: You can stop it any time.

bridge.heading: Beyond the app
bridge.intro: Practice here, then try it for real when you are ready.
bridge.first_account: My first account at a bank
bridge.first_pay1: Check what you got after any deductions.
bridge.first_pay2: Try your usual split on it.
bridge.first_account1: Ask about fees before you open it.
bridge.first_account2: Check it every week, like your coins.
bridge.first_account3: Never share your PIN or password.
bridge.first_budget1: List what you must pay each month.
bridge.first_budget3: Look back at the end of the month.
